record.question: Under the National Quantum Mission (NQM), India targets intermediate-scale quantum systems by 2031. Which outcome best aligns with these targets for near-term applications?
options: Replacing all classical cryptography in government with quantum key distribution by 2026
Demonstrating fault-tolerant universal quantum computing for any algorithm
Establishing quantum simulators with 50–1000 physical qubits for domain-specific problems
Launching a public blockchain fully secured by quantum-resistant algorithms in all nodes
